sermon.title: God’s Rest Part 3 - July 7, 2024
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: After pledges for Independence Day weekend, the God’s Rest series concludes: the rest that remains is ceasing from our own works and our own way. Learn God’s ways, choose godly partners, and take Jesus’ easy yoke. Like Simon, let Jesus into your boat, listen to His teaching, and launch out into the deep at His word.
